scores.decision_correct_quote: Survivable *only after* code changes — the capture path has no per-IP gate (C2) and the MCP path strips the IP (C3), so the proposal's implied controls do not exist yet; quota must be viewport-seconds, not captures (C1); gate = IP+UA hash, global daily budget; kill switch = feature var + `PLAN_LIMITS.trial` zeroing, which cannot touch claimed accounts because they are `plan='free'`.

must_catch.quote: The capture path enforces no per-IP limit at all today — only the per-account daily count. EVIDENCE: `capture.ts:234` calls only `checkDailyUploadLimit`; `checkUploadRateLimit` has exactly one call site, `items-create.ts:70`.

Even the wired per-IP limit is inert for MCP-originated work, because the internal Request carries no `CF-Connecting-IP`. [...] `rate-limit.ts:21` `if (!ip) return { allowed: true };` [...] `1009-1013` constructs captures without client-IP headers.
Setting `plan='trial'` without adding `PLAN_LIMITS.trial` grants 50/day, not 10 — the lookup falls back to free. EVIDENCE: `rate-limit.ts:70` `const limits = PLAN_LIMITS[plan] ?? PLAN_LIMITS.free;`
`0001_initial_schema.sql:9` `email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE` [...] Make account email nullable and add an explicit trial state.
One rung-0 "capture" is up to six full browser page-loads plus six OCR jobs [...] `capture.ts:25` `const MAX_WAIT_MS = 25_000;` [...] Cap trial captures at 1 viewport and `full_page:false`
Link alone must be inert. [...] No bearer credential is ever printed. [...] This link alone grants no access.
Kill switch: flip `FEATURE_RUNG0_TRIAL=0` (stops issuance only) [...] Claimed accounts are `plan='free'` and unaffected.

false_objections.quote: replace trial credentials and device session without grace
false_objections.why: reissue on claim breaks the agent's stored config; conversion is in-place on the same key and device rows

false_objections.quote: Error text returns the claim URL **and** the code; the code is the possession proof, the URL alone is inert.
false_objections.why: a locator plus the possession secret in MCP error/tool text is still a transcript bearer
browser Authorize is consent only; conversion is the trial-key-authenticated CLI poll

scores.notes: Union catches the live capture-limiter bug and the non-bearer requirement, but the possession path is wrong (page-typed code / loopback+Authorize, plus a reissue landmine) rather than a trial-key-authenticated poll.
